name: Cloudflare cf CLI
description: Gives coding agents one CLI over the public Cloudflare API and Workers projects, with JSON output by default, local command search, and typed cloudflare.config.ts files.

skills.name: Command Search
skills.description: Finds the right command for a plain-language task with cf cli search, which runs locally without credentials and returns JSON matches.

skills.name: Request Schema Inspection
skills.description: Shows the API request a generated command sends with cf schema, then previews it with --dry-run before the agent runs it for real.

skills.name: Wrangler Migration
skills.description: Converts a Wrangler project to a typed cloudflare.config.ts with cf migrate, delegating builds to Wrangler where esbuild is still needed.

skills.name: Workers Project Deploys
skills.description: Creates, runs, builds, and deploys Workers projects with cf init, cf dev, cf build, and cf deploy, including prebuilt deploys from CI.
